entries.look: Career → More from the archive → The rivals. Watch the tyres roll in race by race, left to right (grid) or out from the names (tyres). Point at a tyre: its card shows the track's 3D still, the race, and both finishes; every other rival's tyre from that race stays lit. Point at a column's empty slots for the race against the whole field, or at a name for the record. Click (or tap twice) to open the race. Flip By record for the three groups.
